zh.title: Airbus A321 B-LPX 觀測抵達桃園機場
zh.summary: 註冊號 B-LPX；呼號 CRK283；A321 抵達桃園
body: 公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示，一架註冊號為 B-LPX 的 Airbus A321 航空器於臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）被觀測到確認抵達。本站監測系統觀測到該航空器在機場地理圍欄內且氣壓高度顯示為地面狀態，據此判定為 confirmed_arrival。確認抵達時間為 2026 年 8 月 10 日 13 時 52 分 39 秒（UTC），首次有效觀測時間則為同日 12 時 27 分 25 秒（UTC）。
該航空器的 ICAO hex 為 78929f，機型 ICAO 代碼為 A321，機型顯示名稱為 Airbus A321。觀測資料中記錄的呼號為 CRK283，營運者 ICAO 為 CRK。然而營運者 IATA、營運者名稱、營運者中文名稱以及營運者所屬國家或地區均標示為未識別，因此無法從觀測資料本身確認實際營運者身分。
本次觀測的主要資料來源為 Airplanes.live，第二資料來源為 ADSB.lol，交叉確認狀態為 confirmed_by_two_sources。有效觀測筆數為 2 筆。機場 ICAO 代碼為 RCTP，機場名稱為臺灣桃園國際機場。事件 ID 為 fw-1153e755d3a6e6c2。
統計說明欄位指出，系統觀測歷史累積中尚無可比較的長期統計，因此本站無法提供該航空器與機場組合的長期觀測頻率比較。本次觀測結果僅反映公開 ADS-B 資料所記錄的抵達事實，不代表任何官方航班計畫、包機安排或營運者意圖。
由於營運者身分在觀測資料中未被識別，本報導僅以航空器型號與註冊號稱呼該機，不對呼號 CRK283 所對應的營運者進行推測。讀者應注意，呼號與實際營運者之間的關聯須由官方管道確認，本站不作此類判斷。

en.title: Airbus A321 B-LPX Observed Arriving at Taoyuan Airport
en.summary: Registration B-LPX; callsign CRK283; A321 arrival at Taoyuan
body: Public ADS-B observation data shows that an Airbus A321 aircraft registered as B-LPX was observed making a confirmed arrival at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE). The site's monitoring system recorded the aircraft within the airport geofence with barometric altitude indicating ground status, leading to a confirmed_arrival determination. The confirmed arrival time was 2026-08-10T13:52:39Z, with the first valid observation at 2026-08-10T12:27:25Z.

The aircraft's ICAO hex is 78929f, its ICAO aircraft type code is A321, and its display model name is Airbus A321. The recorded callsign is CRK283, and the operator ICAO is CRK. However, the operator IATA, operator name, operator Chinese name, and operator country or region are all marked as unrecognized in the observation data, making it impossible to confirm the actual operator identity from the source alone.

The primary data source for this observation is Airplanes.live, with ADSB.lol as the secondary source, and the cross-confirmation status is confirmed_by_two_sources. The number of valid observation records is 2. The airport ICAO code is RCTP, and the airport name is Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport. The event ID is fw-1153e755d3a6e6c2.

The statistical note indicates that the system's observation history is still accumulating and no comparable long-term statistics are available. Therefore, the site cannot provide any long-term frequency comparison for this aircraft-and-airport combination. This observation reflects only the arrival fact recorded in public ADS-B data and does not represent any official flight plan, charter arrangement, or operator intent.

Because the operator identity is unrecognized in the observation data, this report refers to the aircraft solely by its model and registration number and does not speculate on which operator corresponds to the callsign CRK283. Readers should note that any association between a callsign and an actual operator must be confirmed through official channels; this site does not make such determinations.
